==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am lucid. I am in a sandy jungle. I am thinking about technology.

I let the world melt away. I am floating in a black void. I summon holographic screens around me.

Before bed, I used Deep Research AI to study dream incubation methods. I imagine that my studies are what allowed me to achieve seemingly instant lucidity. I used my time in the void to relax and enjoy feeling weightless, but I don't fully remember what I was thinking about while floating.
